messages:
Priya Patel: quick heads-up — I'm kicking off onboarding for zeta-13b-lite weights. HF source is https://huggingface.co/redwood/zeta-13b-lite/tree/main. planning to mirror to s3://redwood-artifacts/weights/zeta-13b-lite/v1/ and publish a manifest. need perms + presign TTL for the transfer.

Marco Nguyen: can you paste the manifest snippet and checksums? also any tokenizer quirks we should know about?

Priya Patel: pasted manifest (minimal):
```
{
  "model": "zeta-13b-lite",
  "version": "v1",
  "files": [
    {"path": "pytorch_model-00001-of-00008.bin", "sha256": "b94d27b9934d3e08a52e52d7da7dabfade...", "size": "2.1GB"},
    {"path": "pytorch_model-00002-of-00008.bin", "sha256": "c7a1f3c9e0fd...", "size": "2.1GB"},
    {"path": "tokenizer.json", "sha256": "7a1f3c9e0fd45...", "md5": "3b5d5c371295...", "size": "120KB"}
  ]
}
```

Jason R: sha256 looks fine. we prefer both sha256 and md5 in the manifest for legacy tools. also include byte sizes (good).

Priya Patel: adding md5 and sizes now. note about tokenizer: we've seen a pad/offset quirk — tokenizer.json from HF sets bos_token differently which breaks our prefix handling.

Lina Chen: confirmed — tokenizer.vocab is fine but tokenizer.json has "add_prefix_space": true and a different bos_token. I ran the tokenizer sanity script and got a 1-2 token shift on a few prompts. pushed a small compatibility artifact: tokenizer_compat_v1.json to the registry.

Marco Nguyen: okay — plan is to mirror HF weights + also mirror tokenizer_compat_v1 and point serving config at compat version. any objections?

Owen (infra): perms note: s3 target bucket needs write from redwood-ingest-sa and read from artifact-service role. presign TTL default is 15m — for 8x 2GB parts we should set 1h for the mirror job. will we tag objects for audit?

Jason R: agree 1h for initial mirror is fine. CI should validate checksums after upload. i'll add an artifact-ingest/validate-checksum job: runs sha256 + md5, verifies size, and runs tokenization smoke tests. fail fast on mismatch. also fail if any single file > 10GB without chunking metadata.

artifact-bot: mirror-job-789 created -> s3://redwood-artifacts/weights/zeta-13b-lite/v1/ status: queued

Priya Patel: thanks. quick ask — can we bump presign TTL to 60m for this run and tag objects with origin=hf and source-commit? helps auditing and rollback.

Owen (infra): i can set presign_ttl=3600 for mirror-job-789 only, and add tags origin=hf, source_commit=<sha>. will enforce KMS encryption and keep ACL private.

Lina Chen: also we need model config: add "tokenizer_version": "compat-v1" in model card so serving picks the compat tokenizer. i'll open a tiny PR to update model config + manifest note.

Priya Patel: :thumbsup: please open the PR and add the manifest entry. once merged i'll kick off the mirror.

Marco Nguyen: FYI to docs folks — please update the ingest runbook with presign TTL override + chunking advice and the tokenizer compat flow.

Jason R: will add the CI job and post the link here once green. will also include a small preflight that checks bucket-policy and IAM bindings before mirroring.

artifact-bot: mirror-job-789 status: running (3/12 uploads complete)

Priya Patel: copying. i'll monitor the job; if checksum or tokenizer smoke fails i'll ping @Jason and @Lina in this thread.
